planning.assumed: Required M-ADD-01 only. M-NUM-16 is strong support, not compulsory skip-count/memorised table gate. Repeated addition and multiplication notation explicitly introduced. Fixed group-factor description is not used to reject a commuted true expression.
planning.scope: Core3 groups2, repair2/3/1 to2/2/2, transfer4 groups3 plus2 loose. Each group controlled by a native amount0–6; report whole total. Optional separate3×2 step model. Finite context, no unrestricted expression parser.
planning.interaction: Native per-group amounts construct the representation with few clicks; specific group mismatch precedes final total check. Same-sum unequal repair contrasts2/3/1 with2/2/2. Transfer shows4×3+2. Optional stepped model separate from practice preserves valid verdict. No semantic-factor-choice expansion in legacy runtime.
planning.evidenceLimits: Constructing supplied group counts and writing total is bounded practice; no free equation writing, physical packing, independent retention, fluency, efficacy or personal mastery claim.
planning.curriculumVsDesign: Canonical roles/grade/groups/curriculum refs are frozen curriculum facts. Finite scenes, controls and lesson sequencing are original project design; external comparables corroborate concepts, not new normative graph facts or efficacy.
planning.feedbackSemantics: Root-owned input and change handlers each commit semantic edits; explicit check rereads visible task/answer. Edits clear dependent verdict. Separate help/model actions preserve the same still-valid practice verdict. No timers or persistence; pause/resume/reset/dispose clean3 scoped listeners.
